name: Kömpöc (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kömpöc: a green shield with a white horse, a sheep, a cross and a sun and the year 1950, between an oak bough and ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed Kömpöc.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kömpöc arms with branches and scroll
